We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...but in reality, we are a consulting company specialized in IT development and Business improvement. We are active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, Pharmaceutical & Transport.

 

Cream's special recipe

• 1/3 of Personal development

• 1/3 of Collective Intelligence

• 1/3 of Intrapreneurship

And Bonus ingredient: ... Some passionate colleagues ??
What is a Data Engineer at cream?

As a Data Engineer at Cream, you can be in charge of the implementation of BI Business Projects or potentially coaching junior data engineers. As well, be responsible for the development of data ingestion and analytics solutions (data warehouses, data marts, etc.)

 

Your tasks

• Architecting Data Systems: Designing robust and scalable data models to meet business needs

• ETL Development: Creating or improving efficient Extract, Transform, Load processes to integrate and process data

• Performance Optimization: Monitoring and fine-tuning data pipelines and databases For optimal speed and efficiency

• Data Security Implementation: Establishing data security measures to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Working closely with data scientists, analysts, and other teams to understand data requirements and provide technical solutions

• You have at least 2 years experience in data engineering

• You have a Master's degree, preferably in IT (Computer or industrial engineering) or in Business Administration or equivalent by experience (more than 5 years).

• You are used to working with different data tools such as SSAS, SSIS, SSRS, AWS, Azure data factory,  Apache Spark, SQL, Python, Tableau

• You have a good database knowledge (SQL and NoSQL)

• You are fluent in French or Dutch and have full professional capacity in English

• You know what it means to work in an Agile mode

• You are passionate about data, pay attention to details and you bring out concrete analysis to help the business

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

•   Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the transport document compliance checks process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)    
•   Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders to ensure completeness and full compliance    
•   Maintains and reports on performance metrics    
  3) Stakeholder Management 
   
•   Sets up, participates and drives stakeholder conver...

  QUALIFICATIONS 
   
•   Level of Education: Bachelor's Degree in Administration, university degree or equivalent by experience    
•   Experience: Minimum 5 years experience in transport or supply chain operations. Comprehension of financial and logistics flows inherent to the pharma industry. Knowledge on customs regulations would be a plus.    
•   Languages: Proficient in English (verbal and written); other languages are a benefit    
•   Computer skills: Broad PC skills are essential (MS applications Outlook, Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint). Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems is a plus.

•   Excellent verbal and written business communication, as well as strong organizational, project management, analytical and negotiation skills

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

• You act as the first point of contact for key users and ensure timely and high-quality resolution of incidents within our supply chain applications. 
• You perform root cause analysis, identify sustainable solutions, and help prevent recurring issues. 
• You gather user feedback and translate business needs into improvements that enhance operational efficiency and user experience. 
• You maintain system and process documentation, provide training, and support users in strengthening their knowledge and capabilities. 
• You contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and other supply chain solutions. 
• You support international expansion projects, such as new production sites or warehouse locations, and play an active role in testing and user acceptance activities. 
• You build strong relationships with business stakeholders and proactively identify opportunities to optimize processes and systems. 
• You participate in international roll-out projects and facilitate knowledge transfer across the organization.  
As a Service Engineer Supply Chain, you report directly to the Business Applications Team Service Lead and are part of LLBG's international IT team.

 
• You hold a Master's degree or have an equivalent level of experience. 
• You have experience working with ERP systems & knowledge of SAP S/4HANA. 
• You have at least 2 years of experience with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Plant Operations processes. 
• You combine strong analytical skills with a customer-focused and service-oriented mindset. 
• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders in an international environment.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

Do you have a passion for logistics? 

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

As Key Account Manager, you grow the company's business with industrial customers across Europe. You look after existing customers, and you bring in new ones. You spend a lot of time visiting customers, and you work closely with the logistics and purchasing team at headquarters.
    
• Manage and develop existing key accounts in Europe  
• Winning new customers in the company's current markets and applications  
• Spot and develop new projects with customers, from the first technical conversation through to supply  
• Negotiate prices and terms, keeping the agreed margins in mind  
• Prepare the yearly sales budget, track volumes and margin every month  
• Keep a close eye on the market, competitors and customer needs, and share what you learn with the team 
  
• At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales in the chemical industry; experience in coatings, adhesives, sealants or polymer applications is a strong plus  
• You have built your own network of customers in the industry and can add value from your first day

• You are interested in the technical side of the products and can talk about them confidently with buyers and R&D teams  
• You are fluent in English, any other European language is an asset  
• You are happy to travel regularly to customers across Europe

• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

What will you do? 

No two days will be quite the same. You'll combine day-to-day accounting administration with administrative support to the Plant Manager and the monthly payroll coordination.
 
Accounting administration
  
• Encode accounting documents in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: supplier invoices, credit notes, purchase orders and expense reports.  
• Match invoices with orders and deliveries, and follow up on discrepancies with suppliers and colleagues. 
• Follow up on open items and payments. 
• Prepare the information the HQ accounting team needs for the monthly closing and answer their questions. 
• Keep the accounting files complete, well organised and audit-ready.  
Administration – Support to the Plant Manager
  
• Provide administrative support to the Plant Manager:  
• Keep the local administration up to date and help improve administrative processes as the team grows.  
Payroll 
 
Coordinate the monthly payroll with Acerta: collect and send the variable data, follow up on questions and check payslips before validation.
  
• Encode payroll-related documents such as contract changes, absences, leave and overtime. 
• Record payroll data in Dynamics 365 for the HQ accounting team.  
You won't be expected to know every system from day one. Your precision, organisational skills and willingness to learn are what matter most

What do you bring? 
 
• A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in accounting or a related field. 
• 2 to 3 years of experience in accounting administration, ideally combined with payroll support. 
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or a similar ERP. 
• Experience with Acerta or another Belgian social secretariat is an asset. 
• Excellent English, essential for communication with the HQ accounting team. 
• French and/or Dutch is a strong asset. 
• A precise, organised and independent approach.  
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.

jobs.occupation: General Manager - Supply Chain & Logistics Operations
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities
 General Management & Operational Leadership
• Oversee the overall strategic and operational management of the site.
• Lead, develop and motivate the local management team and employees.
• Drive operational excellence, service quality, productivity and performance.
• Maintain a visible presence on site and foster a strong performance culture. Financial Management & Business Performance
• Take full P&L responsibility and ensure sustainable profitability.
• Manage operational costs, monitor financial KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
• Optimise the utilisation of existing facilities and operational capacity. Business Development & Customer Management
• Actively contribute to the site's commercial development and growth.
• Strengthen existing customer relationships and identify new business opportunities.
• Leverage your industry network to attract new customers, particularly within Pharma, Life Sciences and Healthcare.
• Work closely with Sales and Business Development teams to develop opportunities and support commercial negotiations.
• Act as a strategic point of contact for key customers. Stakeholder Management & Compliance
• Ensure effective collaboration across Operations, Sales, HR, Finance, IT, Engineering and QHSE within a matrix organisation.
• Ensure compliance with industry-specific regulations, licences, registrations, quality standards and traceability requirements.
• Promote a strong culture of quality, health and safety. Continuous Improvement & Strategic Development
• Drive process optimisation, digitalisation and productivity improvements.
• Lead strategic site projects and contribute to the organisation's broader development strategy.

Your profile
